tools.name: search_droppy_docs
tools.description: Search everything on getdroppy.app (the Droppy handbook, every droplet page, the DroppyKit developer docs and the blog) and get ranked pages with a snippet. Use it for any question about how Droppy works, its settings, shortcuts, permissions, pricing or problems.

tools.name: fetch_droppy_page
tools.description: Read one page of getdroppy.app as Markdown, by URL or path, for example "/docs/shelf", "https://getdroppy.app/docs/droplets/ring" or "/pricing.md". Use it after search_droppy_docs to read a result in full.

tools.name: list_droplets
tools.description: List Droppy's droplets: the extensions built into Droppy and the ones in the Droplet Store, with a summary and documentation link for each. Filter by text or by kind.
